title: Children
definition: Children are precious gifts from God who bear His image and are to be loved, protected, taught, and guided.
summary: Scripture calls children to honor their parents and calls adults to care for children with tenderness, wisdom, and responsibility.
christFocus: Jesus welcomed children and used them as examples of humble dependence in the kingdom of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture calls children to honor their parents and calls adults to care for children with tenderness, wisdom, and responsibility.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
